parties: S.A.S.Karunawathie Perera v. People\'s Bank and Others S.A.S.Karunawathie Perera v. People\'s Bank and Others View More
keywords: The Petitioner sought the intervention of this Court to quash the 1st Respondent Bank’s decision to acquire her property under Section 71(4) of the Finance Act No. 11 of 1963. The Bank entertained a redemption application by a descendant of the original owner. Held - the Petitioner’s title, derived after the Bank’s prohibition notice, was subject to the Bank’s right of acquisition under Part VIII of the Finance Act; Application dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
